purpose: Separate read-only scope audit. This is not a binder manifest, approval register, art brief extension, or authorization to replace shared graphics.

findings.issue: Native spirits omitted by inventory scan
findings.detail: The scan iterates only MOD/common/ideas and admits HSM_VER/HSM_ERI/HSM_EYR stems or AVI.txt. EaW/common/ideas/zzz_AVI_ideas.txt is never scanned. All 49 country-category definitions are missing; avithreehousescorp is an industrial concern, not a 50th spirit.

findings.issue: All named House portrait fields covered
findings.detail: Compared actual portrait leaf selectors, including both Tripartite College instances, to portrait-bindings.json. All 27 character records and 32 portrait fields are represented. Presence is not a fresh approval/hash/in-game validation.

findings.issue: Shared legacy manufacturers are recorded, not completed
findings.detail: The binder inventories 11 generic legacy manufacturers plus avithreehousescorp. The 11 remain blocked_shared_definition; the unique corporation is batch01_native_override. Do not list the 11 as absent, or their global texture replacements as scoped work.

findings.issue: Generated advisor templates are outside binder discovery
findings.detail: The binder reads the three named character files, not generate_character templates. Erie and Eyrie lack the custom-advisor opt-out in their country history. Avian sets has_custom_advisors, but the separately gated intelligence-chief generator remains relevant. Runtime generated IDs and personal names cannot be inferred as fixed static character IDs.

findings.issue: MIO organization IDs are outside binder discovery
findings.detail: Ten generic MIO definitions have potentially applicable allowed blocks. They are different targets from the eleven legacy designer ideas even when a sprite is shared. Twenty-two archetype-only definitions explicitly allowed=no are excluded from the actionable count.
